Max Cooper, decoded

Ten tracks pulled apart with a pipeline written for this project (music/analyze.py, pure numpy): tempo and pulse type, meter and downbeat, repeating cycle lengths per layer, harmony, structure and lifts, sidechain shape, spectral balance, dynamics and stereo width. Every number below is measured, and the generator in the Studio panel is parameterised from the profile at the bottom.

117.5 BPMmedian tempo · range 96–136
0.57swing (0.50 = straight, 0.67 = triplet)
76odd-length cycles found across layers
252 Hzspectral centroid · tilt -19 dB/decade
-10.7 dBFSRMS · crest 10.7 dB · range 13 dB

0.13sidechain depth median · 0.19 s recovery
2.6note events per beat (arps + percs)

What the ten tracks have in common

  • Tempo lives at 115–125. Median 117.5; the two outliers are the collaborations (8 Billion Realities at 136, When I Sit Alone at 96).
  • Two kick modes. Four-on-the-floor with the kick owning the low end (Becoming, Four Tones Reflected: 53–70% of all low-band hits land on the beat), or a kick on every 8th as a drive (Perpetual Motion, Void). The remaining tracks are irregular on purpose; Order From Chaos has no dominant kick spacing at all.
  • Polymeter is structural, not decorative. 3-beat cycles appear 16 times across hat, perc and melody layers, 7-beat 9 times, 11-beat 8 times. Lines of odd length phasing against a 4/4 bar are the signature. Void's kick layer runs a strong 3-beat cycle inside 4/4.
  • Grooves swing at ~0.57. Not straight, not triplet.
  • Dark, sub-forward mixes. Centroid 252 Hz. Sub at -3 dB relative to total, highs at -25 dB. Bass is mono (side/mid 0.10), highs are very wide (0.86).
  • Dynamic, not brickwalled. RMS -10.7 dBFS with 10.7 dB crest, and a 13 dB loudness range from long quiet intros.
  • Long arcs. Median section 9 bars, 6 sections per track, the first big lift about a quarter of the way in. Tracks run 3.3–7.5 minutes.
  • Harmony moves slowly. Chords change about every two bars (0.48 changes/bar). Tonal centres cluster on A minor and D.
  • Sidechain is light. Depth 0.13 median, up to 0.37 on the four-on-the-floor tracks, recovering in ~0.19 s.

Meter marked “?” means four-on-the-floor with no accent contrast to confirm it — 4/4 by default. Key confidence is the Krumhansl correlation; above 0.8 is solid, 0.6 is a tonal centre rather than a firm key.

Structure

Order From Chaos is a 75-second linear rise from near silence. Void sits quiet for 95 seconds and then arrives in blocks. Becoming holds its peak for four minutes. These are long-arc tracks — there is no EDM drop, which is exactly why the reel engine's drop detector found nothing on seven of them.

Rhythm

Kick probability peaks on the beats but stays busy between them; hats are close to even across the bar with a light on-beat accent. The snare band is contaminated by kick body so its grid is not reliable — Cooper rarely uses a backbeat snare anyway.

Sound

How the generator uses this

  • Default tempo 117, swing 0.57, A minor, 112 bars (~3.8 min).
  • Three kick pulses: four-on-the-floor, 8th-note drive, broken/euclidean.
  • Hat, perc and arp cycle lengths drawn from what was measured: 12, 20, 28, 44 sixteenths (3, 5, 7, 11 beats) plus short odd cycles of 5–13 steps, scaled by the Polymeter dial.
  • Section arc intro → build → peak → breakdown → short build → second peak → outro, in the measured proportions.
  • Chords hold two bars by default; sidechain depth 0.25 with ~0.1 s recovery; a −4.5 dB high shelf and mono sub to match the balance; hats, percs, arp and pad spread wide.
  • Round-trip check: a generated four-on-the-floor track at 118 BPM in A minor analyses back as 117.5 BPM, A minor (0.81), 4/4, steady pulse.

Full numbers per track: music/analysis/<track>.json; cross-track medians: music/analysis/profile.json. Re-run on new material with python3 music/analyze.py <wavs> <out>.
